faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about NeuroCode AI
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code to use NeuroCode AI?
faq.a1: No! NeuroCode was built specifically for people without technical knowledge. You just need to describe what you want in plain language, as if explaining to a friend. The AI handles all the code.
faq.q2: Is the generated code professional and production-ready?
faq.a2: Yes! NeuroCode uses its own AI engine, trained specifically for software generation. The generated code follows best practices, includes error handling, responsiveness and is production-ready.
faq.q3: What types of projects can I create?
faq.a3: You can create complete websites, high-conversion landing pages, interactive web apps, mobile apps (React Native), SaaS platforms, analytics dashboards, REST APIs, automation systems and much more.
faq.q4: Does the generated code belong to me? Can I use it commercially?
faq.a4: Yes! All code generated by NeuroCode belongs 100% to you. There are no commercial use restrictions, no lock-in, no royalties. You can use, modify, sell and distribute as you wish.
faq.q5: How does the customization chat work?
faq.a5: After generating your project, you can open the AI Chat and request any modification in natural language. Examples: 'Change the primary color to blue', 'Add a contact form', 'Create a testimonials section'. The AI understands and applies the changes.
faq.q6: How long does it take to generate a project?
faq.a6: Most projects are generated in 30 to 60 seconds. More complex projects, such as complete SaaS platforms with database and authentication, may take up to 2 minutes.
faq.q7: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a7: Yes, no contracts or penalties. You can cancel your subscription at any time from the settings panel. Your already-created projects remain available for download for 30 days after cancellation.
faq.a8: Yes! The Free plan allows you to create up to 3 projects per month at no cost, with access to the code generator and live preview. It's the perfect way to try the platform before upgrading.

about.title: About NeuroCode AI
about.subtitle: We are a Brazilian startup on a mission to democratize software development.
about.missionText: We believe that anyone with a good idea deserves the ability to turn it into a real digital product — regardless of their technical knowledge.
about.heroBody: NeuroCode AI was born from a simple belief: the ability to create digital products should not be exclusive to those who know how to code. With cutting-edge artificial intelligence, we turn ideas into reality — for anyone, anywhere.
about.timelineSubtitle: The story of how we decided to change the way the world builds software.
about.timeline0desc: We identified that 97% of people with great ideas don't know how to code and are dependent on expensive agencies or developers.
about.timeline1desc: With the arrival of high-capacity LLMs, we started building the first version of the intelligent code generator.
about.timeline2desc: We developed the NeuroCode AI Engine — our proprietary software generation engine — and launched it for the first beta users.
about.timeline3desc: Our platform already helps entrepreneurs, designers and creators transform ideas into real digital products every day.
about.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide every decision we make.
about.value0desc: We believe the ability to build software should not be restricted to those who know how to code.
about.value1desc: From concept to product in minutes — not weeks. The time for your idea is now.
about.value2desc: Code generated with best practices, secure, responsive and production-ready.
about.value3desc: Your code is yours. No lock-in, no royalties, no surprises. Full export always available.
about.value4desc: Built for the Brazilian market — in Portuguese, with prices in reais and local support.
about.value5desc: We use the state of the art in AI — NeuroCode AI Engine — to guarantee the best results.
